title: Germany – Video-surveillance system – LUNA Motion Capturing System
description: The QYRO project is a joint effort of Robert Bosch GmbH, Q.ANT, Trumpf Photonic Components, Trumpf Laser Berlin, Ferdinand-Braun-Institut, Leibniz-Institut für Höchstfrequenztechnik (FBH), and the German Aerospace Center Galileo Competence Center (DLR-GK). Its purpose is to promote Germany’s role in the space sector by demonstrating the performance of a miniaturised next generation quantum optical gyroscope and therefore pave the way for a commercial use of this new technology for a German company on the promising New Space market. Therefore, the project shall design and develop a miniaturized, high precision nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) Gyroscope for the use in the satellites. This quantum-based gyro – QYRO – shall be launched and validated in space against state-of-the-art attitude determination systems for CubeSat missions. For that purpose, DLR’s task in this project is to establish the definition and design of the mission to host the QYRO unit. Followed by supporting the other project partners to manufacture a space qualified version of the ground based QYRO unit. Additionally, DLR KN with the support from GK, will integrate GALANT phased array antenna for space positioning applications, which additionally will be investigated in a first approximation to make the interference detection function usable in space. The payload will be constituted by two QYRO units, the GALANT electronics module together with its antenna module, a reference gyroscope and finally a payload computer. The mission will be launched into an SSO with an apoapsis and periapsis height under 600 km. In terms of operations, communications and the payload on-board computer software, the valuable experience of DLR-SC and DLR-RB will contribute to a successful operation of the CubeSat. The last stage of the project would comprise launching and operating the CubeSat in space to conduct the in-orbit validation test campaign. The Contractor shall be responsible of providing the 16U platform for the Flight Model of PETER, support its integration and testing, contribute to the tools for its control and, additionally, providing the payload computer together with the necessary libraries and tools required to implement the payload control software on it. Further details about the Contractor requirements and responsibilities have been defined in the attached Specification of Services.

description: This contract covers the supply of an atmospheric profiler (Automatic LIDAR Ceilometer, ALC) that can detect and identify the type of cloud base (liquid/solid) and aerosol plumes using LIDAR technology with polarization from the ground for the Royal Meteorological Institute of Belgium (RMI). The RMI currently operates a network of 5 (ALC, without polarization technology), most of which are more than 10 years old and need to be gradually replaced. Over the last five years, an increase in the intensity and frequency of atmospheric episodes transporting sand from the Sahara to Belgium has been observed, as well as an increase in the frequency of smoke plumes reaching Belgium originating from forest fires in the northern hemisphere. The presence of these aerosol plumes at high altitudes can sometimes affect air quality at ground level. The identification and characterization of these aerosol plumes at altitude (using polarization technology) is therefore crucial to quickly meet the expectations of RMI partners concerned with air quality. The objectives of RMI are: - to measure the height of the cloud base. - to determine the height of the mixing layer (a key parameter in predicting air quality) from the attenuated backscatter signal. - to identify liquid and ice clouds and the type of aerosol plumes. The ALC must be operational 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. | Dit contract betreft de levering van een atmosferische profiler (Automatic LIDAR Ceilometer, ALC) die in staat is om de aard van wolkenbasissen (vloeistoffen/ vaste stoffen) en aërosolpluimen te detecteren en te identificeren met behulp van LIDAR-technologie met polarisatie vanaf de grond voor het Koninklijk Meteorologisch Instituut van België (KMI). Het KMI beheert momenteel een netwerk van 5 (ALC, zonder polarisatietechnologie), waarvan de meeste meer dan tien jaar oud zijn en geleidelijk aan moeten worden vervangen. De aanwezigheid van deze aërosolpluimen op grote hoogte kan soms een impact hebben op de luchtkwaliteit aan de grond. De identificatie en karakterisering van deze aërosolpluimen (met behulp van polarisatietechnologie) op hoogte is daarom essentieel om snel te kunnen reageren op de verwachtingen van de KMI-partners die betrokken zijn bij de luchtkwaliteit. De doelstellingen van het KMI zijn : - de hoogte van de wolkenbasis meten. - de hoogte van de menglaag bepalen (een essentiële parameter in luchtkwaliteitsvoorspellingen) op basis van het verzwakte backscatter-signaal. - het identificeren van vloeistof- en ijswolken en de aard van aerosolpluimen. title: Assessorament d'una psicòloga per la realització del Quart exercici. Prova psicotècnica (de caràcter obligatori i eliminatori), convocats 110 aspirants per la seva realització. Les proves psicotècniques són eliminatòries i es qualifiquen com a apte/a o no apte/a. La superació de la prova aptitudinal implica obtenir una puntuació mínima de 50 en cadascun dels subtests que conformen la prova, i 50 en la puntuació global.
